#' Resolve the fixed, installed exact-sum artifact and its qualified runtime.
#' @return Path and reproducible build manifest, after capability/integrity checks.
#' @noRd
diaRollupExtensionInfo <- function() {
    fail <- function() cli::cli_abort("relational DIA rollup requires the qualified Linux exact-sum runtime",
        class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
    if (!identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Linux") || !identical(Sys.info()[["machine"]], "x86_64") ||
        !isTRUE(.Machine$longdouble.digits == 64)) fail()
    root <- system.file("duckdb", "linux_amd64", package = "MultiScholaR")
    manifest_path <- file.path(root, "manifest.rds")
    path <- file.path(root, "dia_rsum.duckdb_extension")
    if (!nzchar(root) || !file.exists(manifest_path) || file.size(manifest_path) > 65536 || !file.exists(path)) fail()
    manifest <- readRDS(manifest_path)
    if (!identical(manifest$schema, 3L) || !isTRUE(manifest$supported) ||
        !identical(manifest$api, "v1.2.0") ||
        !identical(manifest$longdouble_digits, 64L) ||
        !identical(manifest$runtime_release_status, "held") ||
        !identical(as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckdb")), manifest$duckdb) ||
        !identical(as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckplyr")), manifest$duckplyr) ||
        !identical(digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256"), manifest$binary_sha256)) fail()
    if (length(manifest$dependencies) != 2L) fail()
    for (dependency in manifest$dependencies) {
        if (!dependency$package %in% c("duckdb", "duckplyr")) fail()
        dependency_root <- system.file(package = dependency$package)
        files <- names(dependency$files)
        if (!length(files) || any(grepl("(^/|[.][.])", files)) ||
            any(!file.exists(file.path(dependency_root, files)))) fail()
        actual <- vapply(files, function(file) digest::digest(
            file = file.path(dependency_root, file), algo = "sha256"), character(1))
        if (!identical(actual, dependency$files)) fail()
    }
    list(path = normalizePath(path), manifest = manifest)
}

#' Describe the frozen qualification profiles; automatic routing stays off.
#' @param profile Explicit diagnostic profile selected before an action.
#' @return Minimal action settings, never serialized as a live engine object.
#' @noRd
diaRollupProfile <- function(profile = "P0") {
    if (!is.character(profile) || length(profile) != 1L || is.na(profile) ||
        !profile %in% paste0("P", 0:16)) cli::cli_abort("unsupported DIA rollup profile",
            class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
    list(name = profile, preserve_order = profile != "P1", streaming = profile == "P2",
        batches = if (profile %in% c("P3", "P7", paste0("P", 8:16))) 3L else
            if (profile == "P4") 6L else 1L)
}

#' Open the existing action scope with the isolated exact-sum extension.
#' @param store,input Existing validated owner and input specification.
#' @param extension Frozen local extension artifact.
#' @return Scope whose normal release owns connection teardown.
#' @noRd
newDIARelationalScope <- function(store, input, extension = NULL, profile = "P0") {
    artifact <- diaRollupExtensionInfo()
    if (!is.null(extension) && !identical(normalizePath(extension, mustWork = TRUE), artifact$path))
        cli::cli_abort("relational DIA cannot load an external extension", class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
    extension <- artifact$path
    settings <- diaRollupProfile(profile)
    scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(store, input$reference, reader = "arrow")
    ready <- FALSE
    on.exit(if (!ready) releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE)
    stopifnot(is.null(scope$action$connection), .Machine$longdouble.digits == 64L,
        as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckdb")) == "1.5.5", file.exists(extension))
    con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE,
        config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true", temp_directory = "")))
    scope$action$connection <- scope$connection <- con
    scope$dia_rollup_profile <- settings
    scope$dia_rollup_extension <- artifact$manifest$binary_sha256
    DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET threads = 8")
    DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET memory_limit = '12GiB'")
    DBI::dbExecute(con, "SET max_temp_directory_size = '0B'")
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste("SET preserve_insertion_order =", if (settings$preserve_order) "true" else "false"))
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste("LOAD", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, extension)))
    ready <- TRUE
    scope
}

#' Validate the same declared-double scientific contract before aggregation.
#' @param scope,input Validated table owner and declared roles/evidence.
#' @param samples Complete sample selector or NULL.
#' @return Selected input row count; creates only the qc_input view.
#' @noRd
validateDIARelationalInput <- function(scope, input, samples) {
    con <- scope$connection
    q <- function(x) as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, x))
    roles <- input$roles
    fields <- unique(c(unlist(roles), input$evidence, input$annotation))
    metadata <- scope$metadata
    if (any(!fields %in% metadata$columns) ||
        any(vapply(metadata$column_metadata[c(roles$raw, roles$normalised)],
            function(x) !identical(x$typeof, "double"), logical(1))))
        cli::cli_abort("saved rollup requires declared double-precision quantities")
    selector <- if (is.null(samples)) "" else paste0(" WHERE ", q(roles$sample), " IN (",
        paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, samples), collapse = ","), ")")
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE TEMP VIEW qc_input AS SELECT ",
        paste(q(c(fields, ".multischolar_order")), collapse = ","), " FROM read_parquet(",
        DBI::dbQuoteString(con, scope$path), ")", selector))
    keys <- c(roles$sample, roles$protein, roles$peptide, roles$modified, roles$precursor)
    bad_keys <- vapply(keys, function(name) {
        blank <- if (identical(metadata$column_metadata[[name]]$typeof, "character"))
            paste0(" OR regexp_full_match(", q(name), ", '[ \\t\\r\\n]*')") else ""
        paste0("(", q(name), " IS NULL", blank, ")")
    }, character(1))
    if (nrow(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT 1 FROM qc_input WHERE ",
        paste(bad_keys, collapse = " OR "), " LIMIT 1")))) stop("missing or blank identity keys")
    quantities <- q(c(roles$raw, roles$normalised))
    bad_values <- paste0("(", quantities, " IS NOT NULL AND (NOT isfinite(", quantities,
        ") OR ", quantities, " < 0))")
    if (nrow(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT 1 FROM qc_input WHERE ",
        paste(bad_values, collapse = " OR "), " LIMIT 1")))) stop("negative or non-finite abundance")
    identity <- paste(q(c(roles$sample, roles$protein, roles$precursor)), collapse = ",")
    if (nrow(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT 1 FROM qc_input GROUP BY ", identity,
        " HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 1")))) stop("duplicate precursor identities")
    if (length(input$evidence)) {
        fields <- paste(q(c(roles$protein, input$evidence)), collapse = ",")
        if (nrow(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ", fields,
            " FROM qc_input) GROUP BY ", q(roles$protein), " HAVING count(*) > 1 LIMIT 1"))))
            stop("conflicting frozen identification evidence")
    }
    as.integer(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT count(*) n FROM qc_input")$n)
}

#' Stream a DuckDB query through Arrow rather than DBI's full R resultset.
#' @param con,query Owned connection and fixed quoted query.
#' @param consume One bounded-batch consumer.
#' @return NULL invisibly, after closing result and Arrow reader.
#' @noRd
streamDIARelationalQuery <- function(con, query, consume, streaming = FALSE) {
    if (streaming) {
        if (!requireNamespace("nanoarrow", quietly = TRUE)) cli::cli_abort(
            "streaming DIA rollup requires the qualified nanoarrow dependency", class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
        result <- DBI::dbSendQueryArrow(con, query)
        on.exit(DBI::dbClearResult(result), add = TRUE)
        repeat {
            part <- DBI::dbFetchArrowChunk(result, chunk_size = 10000L)
            data <- as.data.frame(part)
            if (!nrow(data)) break
            stopifnot(nrow(data) <= 10000L, as.numeric(object.size(data)) <= 67108864)
            consume(data)
        }
        return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    result <- DBI::dbSendQuery(con, query, arrow = TRUE)
    on.exit(DBI::dbClearResult(result), add = TRUE)
    reader <- duckdb::duckdb_fetch_record_batch(result, chunk_size = 10000L)
    on.exit(reader$.unsafe_delete(), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    repeat {
        batch <- reader$read_next_batch()
        if (is.null(batch)) break
        data <- as.data.frame(batch)
        stopifnot(nrow(data) <= 10000L, as.numeric(object.size(data)) <= 67108864)
        consume(data)
    }
    invisible(NULL)
}

#' Collapse bounded distinct annotations with the established native token helper.
#' @param scope,input Current query scope and declared annotation roles.
#' @return Small annotation lookup only, never the assay.
#' @noRd
readDIARelationalAnnotations <- function(scope, input) {
    con <- scope$connection
    protein <- input$roles$protein
    key <- as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, protein))
    out <- stats::setNames(data.frame(rep(NA_character_, 10000L), rep(NA_character_, 10000L)),
        c(protein, "Protein.Ids"))
    values <- rep(NA_character_, 10000L)
    count <- groups <- 0L
    current <- NULL
    finish <- function() {
        if (!count) return(invisible(NULL))
        groups <<- groups + 1L
        if (groups > 10000L) stop("annotation lookup exceeds key limit")
        out[groups, ] <<- list(current, collapseRollupProteinIds(values[seq_len(count)]))
        count <<- 0L
    }
    streamDIARelationalQuery(con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT ", key,
        ', "Protein.Ids" FROM qc_input ORDER BY ', key, ', "Protein.Ids"'), function(part) {
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(part))) {
            next_key <- part[[protein]][[i]]
            if (count && !identical(current, next_key)) finish()
            current <<- next_key
            count <<- count + 1L
            if (count > 10000L) stop("annotation lookup exceeds values limit")
            values[[count]] <<- part$Protein.Ids[[i]]
        }
        stopifnot(as.numeric(object.size(out)) <= 67108864,
            as.numeric(object.size(values)) <= 67108864)
    }, streaming = scope$dia_rollup_profile$streaming)
    finish()
    out[seq_len(groups), , drop = FALSE]
}

#' Build exactly one lazy aggregation using SQL or duckplyr's relational API.
#' @param scope,input Scientific input scope and roles.
#' @param arm C or D.
#' @return NULL invisibly; qc_aggregated is a lazy view, not a temporary assay.
#' @noRd
prepareDIARelationalAggregate <- function(scope, input, arm) {
    con <- scope$connection
    roles <- input$roles
    q <- function(x) as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, x))
    group <- c(roles$sample, roles$protein, roles$peptide)
    # Blank factor labels are allowed by the native key check but not counted as forms.
    DBI::dbExecute(con, "DROP VIEW IF EXISTS qc_aggregated")
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW qc_prepared AS SELECT *, CASE WHEN ",
        "regexp_full_match(CAST(", q(roles$modified), " AS VARCHAR), '[ \\t\\r\\n]*') ",
        "THEN NULL ELSE CAST(", q(roles$modified), " AS VARCHAR) END AS dia_modified FROM qc_aggregate_input"))
    if (arm == "C") {
        query <- paste0("SELECT ", paste(q(group), collapse = ","),
            ", dia_r_sum(list(", q(roles$raw), ' ORDER BY ".multischolar_order")) AS "Peptide.RawQuantity",',
            " dia_r_sum(list(", q(roles$normalised), ' ORDER BY ".multischolar_order")) AS "Peptide.Normalised",',
            " count(DISTINCT dia_modified) AS peptidoform_count, count(", q(roles$raw), ") AS raw_observed, count(",
            q(roles$normalised), ") AS normalised_observed, count(*) AS source_count FROM qc_prepared GROUP BY ",
            paste(q(group), collapse = ","))
        DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE TEMP VIEW qc_aggregated AS ", query))
    } else {
        stopifnot(arm == "D", as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckplyr")) == "1.2.1")
        frame <- duckplyr::read_sql_duckdb("SELECT * FROM qc_prepared", con = scope$connection, prudence = "stingy")
        relation <- duckdb:::rel_from_altrep_df(frame, strict = FALSE, allow_materialized = FALSE)
        stopifnot(!is.null(relation))
        ref <- duckplyr::relexpr_reference
        fun <- duckplyr::relexpr_function
        sum_expr <- function(column, alias) fun("dia_r_sum", list(fun("list", list(ref(column)),
            order_bys = list(ref(".multischolar_order")))), alias = alias)
        aggregates <- list(sum_expr(roles$raw, "Peptide.RawQuantity"),
            sum_expr(roles$normalised, "Peptide.Normalised"),
            fun("list_unique", list(fun("list", list(ref("dia_modified")))), alias = "peptidoform_count"),
            fun("count", list(ref(roles$raw)), alias = "raw_observed"),
            fun("count", list(ref(roles$normalised)), alias = "normalised_observed"),
            fun("count_star", list(), alias = "source_count"))
        relation <- duckplyr::rel_aggregate(relation, groups = lapply(group, ref), aggregates = aggregates)
        # Pinned DuckDB bridge exports the lazy relation without collecting to R.
        duckdb:::rel_to_view(relation, "main", "qc_aggregated", TRUE)
    }
    invisible(NULL)
}

#' Prepare a projected sample-aligned file without collecting the assay in R.
#' @param scope,input Existing scientific owner and roles.
#' @param samples Canonically ordered complete sample identifiers.
#' @param path Private staging path owned by the existing writer request.
#' @return NULL after synchronous Parquet publication; immutable source ordinals are retained.
#' @noRd
prepareDIARelationalLayout <- function(scope, input, samples, path) {
    con <- scope$connection
    q <- \(x) as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, x))
    fields <- unique(c(unlist(input$roles[c("sample", "protein", "peptide", "modified", "raw", "normalised")]),
        ".multischolar_order"))
    stopifnot(!".dia_sample_rank" %in% fields)
    ranks <- data.frame(value = samples, rank = seq_along(samples))
    DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "qc_sample_ranks", ranks, temporary = TRUE)
    query <- paste0("SELECT ", paste(paste0("s.", q(fields)), collapse = ","),
        ', r.rank AS ".dia_sample_rank" FROM qc_input s JOIN qc_sample_ranks r ON s.',
        q(input$roles$sample), ' = r.value ORDER BY r.rank, s.".multischolar_order"')
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("COPY (", query, ") TO ", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, path),
        " (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION SNAPPY, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 122880)"))
    invisible(NULL)
}

#' Stage one complete sample cohort through the explicitly selected native engine.
#' @param con Owned DuckDB connection.
#' @param source,path Existing aligned file and private cohort output path.
#' @param ranks Inclusive complete-sample rank range.
#' @param fast Use fastduckdb's file-to-file streaming API at eight threads.
#' @return NULL after the cohort has been completely written.
#' @noRd
stageDIARelationalCohort <- function(con, source, path, ranks, fast) {
    if (fast) {
        if (!requireNamespace("fastduckdb", quietly = TRUE)) cli::cli_abort(
            "fast DIA staging requires the qualified fastduckdb package", class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
        on.exit(fastduckdb::clear_parquet_cache(), add = TRUE)
        fastduckdb::stream_parquet_filter_fast(source, path, ".dia_sample_rank", ranks[[1L]],
            max_val = ranks[[2L]], compression = "snappy", n_threads = 8L)
    } else {
        DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("COPY (SELECT * FROM read_parquet(", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, source),
            ') WHERE ".dia_sample_rank" BETWEEN ', ranks[[1L]], " AND ", ranks[[2L]], ") TO ",
            DBI::dbQuoteString(con, path), " (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION SNAPPY, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 262144)"))
    }
    invisible(NULL)
}

#' Drain one ordered result file through bounded, matched eight-thread readers.
#' @param con Owned DuckDB connection, also used by the matched control.
#' @param path Private result Parquet with explicit consecutive output ordinals.
#' @param consume Existing codec/summary/writer callback.
#' @param fast Select fastduckdb; both arms collect at most 10000 rows / 64 MiB.
#' @return Number of bounded read calls after all readers have been released.
#' @noRd
streamDIARelationalResultFile <- function(con, path, consume, fast) {
    if (fast && !requireNamespace("fastduckdb", quietly = TRUE)) cli::cli_abort(
        "fast DIA result reads require the qualified fastduckdb package", class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
    quoted <- as.character(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, path))
    rows <- as.integer(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT count(*) n FROM read_parquet(", quoted, ")"))$n)
    calls <- 0L
    if (!rows) return(calls)
    for (start in seq.int(1L, rows, by = 10000L)) {
        end <- min(rows, start + 9999L)
        part <- if (fast) tryCatch(fastduckdb::read_parquet_fast(path, n_threads = 8L,
            lazy_strings = FALSE, filter = list(.dia_output_order = c(start, end))),
            finally = fastduckdb::clear_parquet_cache()) else
            DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0('SELECT * FROM read_parquet(', quoted,
                ') WHERE ".dia_output_order" BETWEEN ', start, " AND ", end,
                ' ORDER BY ".dia_output_order"'))
        if (is.unsorted(part$.dia_output_order)) part <- part[order(part$.dia_output_order), , drop = FALSE]
        stopifnot(identical(as.integer(part$.dia_output_order), seq.int(start, end)),
            nrow(part) <= 10000L, as.numeric(object.size(part)) <= 67108864)
        part$.dia_output_order <- NULL
        consume(part)
        calls <- calls + 1L
    }
    calls
}

#' Stream the ordered aggregation and joins into the existing staged writer.
#' @param scope,input,persist Existing scope, roles and native output schema/identity.
#' @param rows Selected precursor row count.
#' @return Existing result reference, exact summary and dependency/count structures.
#' @noRd
persistDIARelationalRollup <- function(scope, input, persist, rows, arm = "D") {
    con <- scope$connection
    roles <- input$roles
    persist$identity$software <- digest::digest(list(persist$identity$software,
        exact_sum = scope$dia_rollup_extension), algo = "sha256")
    q <- function(x) as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, x))
    joins <- ""
    evidence_rows <- evidence_bytes <- 0
    select <- paste0("a.", q(c(roles$sample, roles$protein, roles$peptide,
        "Peptide.RawQuantity", "Peptide.Normalised", "peptidoform_count")))
    if (length(input$evidence)) {
        fields <- paste(q(c(roles$protein, input$evidence)), collapse = ",")
        evidence <- paste0("(SELECT DISTINCT ", fields, " FROM qc_input)")
        if (scope$dia_rollup_profile$name == "P7") {
            # Validation has established one evidence tuple per protein globally.
            # Only this bounded lookup is materialized, never an assay intermediate.
            DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE TEMP TABLE qc_evidence AS SELECT DISTINCT ",
                fields, " FROM qc_input LIMIT 10001"))
            widths <- paste0("coalesce(octet_length(encode(CAST(",
                q(c(roles$protein, input$evidence)), " AS VARCHAR))), 0)")
            footprint <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT count(*) AS rows, coalesce(sum(64 + ",
                paste(widths, collapse = " + "), "), 0) AS bytes FROM qc_evidence"))
            if (footprint$rows > 10000 || footprint$bytes > 67108864) cli::cli_abort(
                "DIA evidence lookup exceeds qualified limits", class = "dia_rollup_unavailable")
            evidence_rows <- as.numeric(footprint$rows)
            evidence_bytes <- as.numeric(footprint$bytes)
            evidence <- "qc_evidence"
        }
        joins <- paste0(joins, " LEFT JOIN ", evidence, " e ON a.",
            q(roles$protein), " = e.", q(roles$protein))
        select <- c(select, paste0("e.", q(input$evidence)))
    }
    if (length(input$annotation)) {
        DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "qc_annotations", readDIARelationalAnnotations(scope, input), temporary = TRUE)
        joins <- paste0(joins, " LEFT JOIN qc_annotations n ON a.", q(roles$protein), " = n.", q(roles$protein))
        select <- c(select, 'n."Protein.Ids"')
    }
    order <- vapply(c(roles$sample, roles$protein, roles$peptide), function(field) {
        column <- paste0("a.", q(field))
        levels <- scope$metadata$column_metadata[[field]]$levels
        if (is.null(levels)) return(column)
        paste0("CASE ", column, " ", paste(paste0("WHEN ", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, levels),
            " THEN ", seq_along(levels)), collapse = " "), " END")
    }, character(1))
    sample_order <- sub("a[.]", "", order[[1L]], fixed = FALSE)
    sample_values <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT DISTINCT ", q(roles$sample),
        " FROM qc_input ORDER BY ", sample_order))[[1L]]
    if (length(sample_values) > 10000L) cli::cli_abort("DIA sample count exceeds qualified limits")
    batches <- scope$dia_rollup_profile$batches
    selections <- if (!length(sample_values)) list(character()) else
        split(sample_values, ceiling(seq_along(sample_values) * batches / length(sample_values)))
    max_group_rows <- 0L
    intermediate_bytes <- 0
    intermediate_bytes_written <- 0
    fastduckdb_calls <- 0L
    profile <- scope$dia_rollup_profile$name
    phase <- scope$dia_rollup_phase
    if (!is.function(phase)) phase <- \(label, fn) fn()
    staged_output <- profile %in% c("P11", "P12")
    if (staged_output) select <- c(select, paste0("row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ",
        paste(order, collapse = ","), ') AS ".dia_output_order"'))
    query <- paste0("SELECT ", paste(c(select, "a.raw_observed", "a.normalised_observed", "a.source_count"),
        collapse = ","), " FROM qc_aggregated a", joins, " ORDER BY ", paste(order, collapse = ","))
    metadata <- workflowSavedTableMetadata(persist$prototype, ".rownames", 3L)
    metadata$rows <- NULL
    counts <- newDIAFilteringAccumulator(persist$prototype, roles$protein)
    summary <- list(aggregation_rule = "linear_sum_modified_unmodified_and_charge_states",
        active_protein_key = roles$protein, precursor_identity_mode = "declared_precursor_id",
        input_precursor_rows = rows, unique_precursor_identities = rows,
        output_stripped_peptide_identities = 0L, raw_partial_missing_outputs = 0L,
        raw_all_missing_outputs = 0L, normalised_partial_missing_outputs = 0L,
        normalised_all_missing_outputs = 0L,
        frozen_identification_evidence = if (length(input$evidence)) "preserved" else "absent",
        protein_ids_provenance = if (length(input$annotation)) "preserved" else
            if (roles$protein == "Protein.Ids") "active_key" else "absent")
    reference <- saveWorkflowTable(scope$store, NULL, basename(tempfile("relational-rollup-")),
        persist$identity, metadata$key_column, metadata = metadata, write_fn = function(path, restoration) {
            writer_backend <- switch(profile, P13 = "fast_arrow", P14 = "fast_r", P15 = "fast_r", P16 = "fast_r", "arrow")
            writer <- openWorkflowTableWriter(path, restoration, scope$store$progress, backend = writer_backend,
                optimization = switch(profile, P15 = "metadata", P16 = "batch", "none"))
            on.exit(abortWorkflowTableWriter(writer), add = TRUE)
            appendWorkflowTableWriter(writer, persist$prototype, integer())
            intermediate <- file.path(dirname(path), "aggregate-intermediate.parquet")
            aligned <- file.path(dirname(path), "sample-aligned.parquet")
            cohort <- file.path(dirname(path), "sample-cohort.parquet")
            result_file <- file.path(dirname(path), "ordered-result.parquet")
            stage_paths <- c(intermediate, aligned, cohort, result_file)
            on.exit(unlink(stage_paths[file.exists(stage_paths)]), add = TRUE)
            record_stage <- function(file) {
                intermediate_bytes_written <<- intermediate_bytes_written + file.size(file)
                intermediate_bytes <<- max(intermediate_bytes,
                    sum(file.size(stage_paths[file.exists(stage_paths)])))
            }
            aligned_input <- profile %in% c("P8", "P9", "P10")
            if (aligned_input && length(sample_values)) {
                phase("sample_layout_prepare", \() prepareDIARelationalLayout(scope, input, sample_values, aligned))
                record_stage(aligned)
            }
            for (batch_index in seq_along(selections)) {
                sample_selection <- selections[[batch_index]]
                cohort <- file.path(dirname(path), paste0("sample-cohort-", batch_index, ".parquet"))
                result_file <- file.path(dirname(path), paste0("ordered-result-", batch_index, ".parquet"))
                stage_paths <- c(intermediate, aligned, cohort, result_file)
                if (!length(sample_selection) && profile %in% paste0("P", 8:12)) next
                filter <- if (!length(sample_selection)) "FALSE" else paste0(q(roles$sample), " IN (",
                    paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, sample_selection), collapse = ","), ")")
                # qc_input already contains the selected population. P6 isolates
                # the cost of selecting it a second time in the single-batch arm.
                selector <- if (scope$dia_rollup_profile$name == "P6") "" else paste0(" WHERE ", filter)
                source_query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM qc_input", selector)
                if (aligned_input) {
                    ranks <- range(match(sample_selection, sample_values))
                    stopifnot(all(is.finite(ranks)))
                    source_query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM read_parquet(", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, aligned),
                        ') WHERE ".dia_sample_rank" BETWEEN ', ranks[[1L]], " AND ", ranks[[2L]])
                    if (profile %in% c("P9", "P10")) {
                        if (file.exists(cohort)) unlink(cohort)
                        phase("sample_cohort_stage", \() stageDIARelationalCohort(con, aligned, cohort,
                            ranks, fast = profile == "P10"))
                        record_stage(cohort)
                        if (profile == "P10") fastduckdb_calls <<- fastduckdb_calls + 1L
                        source_query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM read_parquet(", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, cohort), ")")
                    }
                }
                DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW qc_aggregate_input AS ", source_query))
                prepareDIARelationalAggregate(scope, input, arm)
                if (scope$dia_rollup_profile$name == "P5") {
                    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("COPY (SELECT * FROM qc_aggregated) TO ",
                        DBI::dbQuoteString(con, intermediate), " (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION SNAPPY)"))
                    intermediate_bytes <<- file.size(intermediate)
                    DBI::dbExecute(con, "DROP VIEW qc_aggregated")
                    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE TEMP VIEW qc_aggregated AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet(",
                        DBI::dbQuoteString(con, intermediate), ")"))
                }
                consume <- function(part) {
                summary$output_stripped_peptide_identities <<- summary$output_stripped_peptide_identities + nrow(part)
                max_group_rows <<- max(max_group_rows, as.integer(part$source_count))
                for (quantity in c("raw", "normalised")) {
                    observed <- part[[paste0(quantity, "_observed")]]
                    partial <- paste0(quantity, "_partial_missing_outputs")
                    missing <- paste0(quantity, "_all_missing_outputs")
                    summary[[partial]] <<- summary[[partial]] + sum(observed > 0 & observed < part$source_count)
                    summary[[missing]] <<- summary[[missing]] + sum(observed == 0)
                }
                output <- restoreSavedWorkflowTable(part, restoration, restoration$columns)
                counts$push(output)
                appendWorkflowTableWriter(writer, output)
                }
                if (staged_output) {
                    phase("ordered_result_stage", \() DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("COPY (", query,
                        ") TO ", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, result_file),
                        " (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION SNAPPY, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 10240)")))
                    record_stage(result_file)
                    calls <- phase("staged_result_read_summary_write", \()
                        streamDIARelationalResultFile(con, result_file, consume, fast = profile == "P12"))
                    if (profile == "P12") fastduckdb_calls <<- fastduckdb_calls + calls
                    unlink(result_file)
                } else streamDIARelationalQuery(con, query, consume,
                    streaming = scope$dia_rollup_profile$streaming)
                if (file.exists(cohort)) unlink(cohort)
            }
            finishWorkflowTableWriter(writer)
        })
    list(reference = reference, summary = summary, columns = metadata$columns,
        dependencies = list(input$reference), counts = counts$finish(),
        execution = list(profile = scope$dia_rollup_profile, samples = length(sample_values),
            projected_row_bytes = workflowProjectedRowBytes(scope$metadata,
                unique(c(unlist(roles), input$evidence, input$annotation))),
            max_group_rows = max_group_rows, output_groups = summary$output_stripped_peptide_identities,
            staged_bytes = reference$payload$bytes, engine_threads = 8L,
            intermediate_bytes = intermediate_bytes,
            intermediate_bytes_written = intermediate_bytes_written,
            fastduckdb_calls = fastduckdb_calls,
            fastduckdb_threads = if (profile %in% c("P10", "P12")) 8L else 0L,
            writer_backend = switch(profile, P13 = "fast_arrow", P14 = "fast_r", P15 = "fast_r", P16 = "fast_r", "arrow"),
            writer_optimization = switch(profile, P15 = "metadata", P16 = "batch", "none"),
            writer_threads = if (profile %in% c("P13", "P14", "P15", "P16")) 8L else NA_integer_,
            evidence_rows = evidence_rows, evidence_payload_estimate = evidence_bytes,
            exact_sum_sha256 = scope$dia_rollup_extension))
}

#' Fingerprint a completed rollup through bounded independent codec reads.
#' @param owned Existing replay root whose immutable payload is being checked.
#' @param reference Accepted result descriptor.
#' @param samples Optional complete sample IDs for an existing full reference.
#' @return Ordered SHA256 fingerprints, without retaining result batches.
#' @noRd
fingerprintDIAWriterOutput <- function(owned, reference, samples = NULL) {
    identity <- readSavedStoreIdentity(file.path(owned, ".workflow-entities", "store.json"))
    store <- newWorkflowEntityStore(owned, identity$project_id, identity$workflow_id)
    on.exit(closeWorkflowEntityStore(store), add = TRUE)
    # JSON receipts simplify empty lists and descriptor types. The immutable RDS
    # is the authority; verify its identity before opening the ordinary read scope.
    canonical <- readRDS(file.path(store$directory, dirname(reference$payload$relative_path),
        "descriptor.rds"))
    stopifnot(identical(canonical$entity_id, reference$entity_id))
    reference <- canonical
    scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(store, reference, reader = "arrow")
    on.exit(releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    hashes <- character()
    streamSavedWorkflowTable(scope, scope$metadata$columns, function(data, offset, row_names) {
        if (!is.null(samples)) data <- data[as.character(data$Run) %in% samples, , drop = FALSE]
        if (!nrow(data)) return(invisible(NULL))
        attr(data, "dia_source_order") <- NULL
        attr(data, "row.names") <- .set_row_names(nrow(data))
        hashes[[length(hashes) + 1L]] <<- digest::digest(data, algo = "sha256")
    })
    hashes
}

#' Instrument copies of the writer boundary for untimed attribution only.
#' @return Diagnostic bindings and scalar-only observations; no assay owners retained.
#' @noRd
makeDIAWriterDiagnostic <- function() {
    observations <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
    observations$costs <- list()
    observations$native <- list()
    observations$completed <- observations$failed <- 0L
    observe <- function(label, seconds, bytes = 0, whole = FALSE) {
        previous <- observations$costs[[label]] %||% list(calls = 0L,
            seconds = 0, bytes = 0, whole_batches = 0L)
        observations$costs[[label]] <- list(calls = previous$calls + 1L,
            seconds = previous$seconds + seconds, bytes = previous$bytes + bytes,
            whole_batches = previous$whole_batches + as.integer(whole))
    }
    diagnostic_env <- new.env(parent = environment(appendWorkflowTableWriter))
    diagnostic_env$observe <- observe
    diagnostic_env$observations <- observations
    append <- appendWorkflowTableWriter
    environment(append) <- diagnostic_env
    code <- as.list(body(append))
    matched <- 0L
    for (i in seq_along(code)) {
        expression <- code[[i]]
        if (is.call(expression) && identical(expression[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
            is.symbol(expression[[2L]]) &&
            as.character(expression[[2L]]) %in% c("storage", "schema_metadata")) {
            label <- as.character(expression[[2L]])
            code[[i]] <- bquote({
                diagnostic_started <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
                .(expression)
                if (writer$backend == "fast_r") observe(.(label),
                    as.numeric(Sys.time()) - diagnostic_started,
                    as.numeric(object.size(.(as.name(label)))),
                    identical(at, seq_len(nrow(table))))
            })
            matched <- matched + 1L
        }
        if (is.call(expression) && identical(expression[[1L]], as.name("if")) &&
            identical(expression[[2L]], quote(writer$backend == "fast_r"))) {
            branch <- as.list(expression[[3L]])
            branch <- base::append(branch, list(quote(diagnostic_complete <- TRUE)),
                after = length(branch) - 1L)
            expression[[3L]] <- as.call(branch)
            code[[i]] <- expression
        }
    }
    stopifnot(matched == 2L)
    code <- base::append(code, list(quote(diagnostic_complete <- FALSE), quote(on.exit({
        if (writer$backend == "fast_r") {
            if (diagnostic_complete) observations$completed <- observations$completed + 1L else
                observations$failed <- observations$failed + 1L
        }
    }, add = TRUE))), after = 1L)
    body(append) <- as.call(code)
    update <- updateWorkflowFastWriter
    environment(update) <- diagnostic_env
    code <- as.list(body(update))
    code <- base::append(code, list(quote(observations$native[[writer$path]] <- info)), after = 1L)
    body(update) <- as.call(code)
    list(append = append, update = update, observations = observations)
}

#' Make diagnostic-only copies of the query boundary, leaving timed functions intact.
#' @param root Existing guarded member directory.
#' @param observe Scalar boundary observer; never receives assay objects.
#' @return Two bindings for one test scope.
#' @noRd
makeDIARollupDiagnostic <- function(root, observe) {
    original_scope <- newDIARelationalScope
    scope_fn <- function(...) {
        scope <- original_scope(...)
        ready <- FALSE
        on.exit(if (!ready) releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE)
        DBI::dbExecute(scope$connection, "SET profiling_mode = 'detailed'")
        DBI::dbExecute(scope$connection, "SET enable_profiling = 'json'")
        DBI::dbExecute(scope$connection, paste("SET profiling_output =",
            DBI::dbQuoteString(scope$connection, file.path(root, "duckdb-profile.json"))))
        ready <- TRUE
        scope
    }
    stream_fn <- streamDIARelationalQuery
    diagnostic_env <- new.env(parent = environment(stream_fn))
    diagnostic_env$observe <- observe
    diagnostic_env$root <- root
    diagnostic_env$query_number <- 0L
    environment(stream_fn) <- diagnostic_env
    code <- as.list(body(stream_fn))
    matched <- 0L
    for (i in seq_along(code)) {
        expression <- code[[i]]
        if (is.call(expression) && identical(expression[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
            identical(expression[[2L]], as.name("result"))) {
            code[[i]] <- quote({
                query_number <<- query_number + 1L
                plan <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste("EXPLAIN", query))
                text <- utils::capture.output(print(plan))
                stopifnot(sum(nchar(text, type = "bytes")) <= 1048576)
                writeLines(text, file.path(root, paste0("query-plan-", query_number, ".txt")))
                observe("before_execute")
                result <- DBI::dbSendQuery(con, query, arrow = TRUE)
                observe("after_execute")
            })
            matched <- matched + 1L
        }
        if (identical(expression, quote(on.exit(DBI::dbClearResult(result), add = TRUE)))) {
            code[[i]] <- quote(on.exit({
                observe("before_clear")
                DBI::dbClearResult(result)
                observe("after_clear")
            }, add = TRUE))
        }
    }
    stopifnot(matched == 1L)
    body(stream_fn) <- as.call(code)
    list(scope = scope_fn, stream = stream_fn)
}

#' Load only the frozen rollup functions, without registering historical S4 methods.
#' @param proof Existing evidence root containing x3Dkg2.
#' @return Frozen helper with its original private function environment.
#' @noRd
bulkRollupFrozenKernel <- function(proof) {
    path <- file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.x3Dkg2", "source", "R", "func_prot_rollup_methods.R")
    frozen <- new.env(parent = asNamespace("MultiScholaR"))
    helpers <- c(".rollupSumObservedOrNA", ".rollupAssertPopulatedKey", ".rollupAssertLinearQuantity",
        ".rollupDuplicateExamples", ".rollupSummarisePrepared", "rollUpPrecursorToPeptideHelper")
    for (expr in parse(path)) {
        if (is.call(expr) && identical(expr[[1L]], as.name("<-")) && is.symbol(expr[[2L]]) &&
            as.character(expr[[2L]]) %in% helpers) eval(expr, frozen)
    }
    stopifnot(all(vapply(helpers, exists, logical(1), envir = frozen, inherits = FALSE)))
    frozen$rollUpPrecursorToPeptideHelper
}

#' Assemble the experimental bulk input through the existing bounded reader/buffer.
#' @param scope Validated source scope.
#' @param input Declared rollup roles and optional evidence/annotation.
#' @param samples Complete sample identities, or NULL for the full population.
#' @return One table, in original source order, with no retained batch list.
#' @noRd
readDIABulkRollup <- function(scope, input, samples = NULL) {
    fields <- unique(c(unlist(input$roles), input$evidence, input$annotation))
    selected <- NULL
    if (!is.null(samples)) {
        index <- saveWorkflowGroupIndex(scope, input$roles$sample)
        groups <- readWorkflowIndexDirectory(scope$store, index$value$groups)
        groups <- groups[match(samples, as.character(groups$value)), , drop = FALSE]
        stopifnot(!anyNA(groups$size))
        index_scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(scope$store, index$value$positions, reader = "arrow")
        on.exit(releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(index_scope), add = TRUE)
        index_rows <- sort(unlist(Map(seq.int, groups$start, length.out = groups$size)))
        selected <- integer(sum(groups$size))
        streamSavedWorkflowTable(index_scope, "source_order", function(data, offset, row_names) {
            selected[offset + seq_len(nrow(data))] <<- data$source_order
        }, source_rows = index_rows)
        releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(index_scope)
        selected <- sort(selected)
    }
    rows <- if (is.null(samples)) scope$metadata$rows else length(selected)
    buffer <- newWorkflowTableBuffer(scope$metadata, fields, rows)
    streamSavedWorkflowTable(scope, fields, function(data, offset, row_names) {
        at <- offset + seq_len(nrow(data))
        source_order <- if (is.null(selected)) at else attr(data, "dia_source_order")
        assignWorkflowTableBuffer(buffer, data, at, source_order, row_names)
    }, source_rows = selected)
    table <- finishWorkflowTableBuffer(buffer)
    attr(table, "workflow_source_order") <- NULL
    table
}

#' Execute and persist one native bulk call using unchanged scientific kernels.
#' @param store,input,persist Existing rollup adapter arguments.
#' @param kernel Frozen or current helper; never traced or wrapped internally.
#' @param cluster Eight baseline workers or NA for the current serial branch.
#' @param samples Complete sample selector or NULL.
#' @param phase Natural-boundary timing callback.
#' @return Existing reference, summary, dependency and filtering-count contract.
#' @noRd
computeDIABulkRollup <- function(store, input, persist, kernel, cluster, samples, phase) {
    scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(store, input$reference, reader = "arrow")
    on.exit(releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE)
    table <- phase("read", function() readDIABulkRollup(scope, input, samples))
    releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope)
    roles <- input$roles
    result <- phase("kernel", function() kernel(table,
        sample_id_column = roles$sample, protein_id_column = roles$protein,
        peptide_sequence_column = roles$peptide, modified_peptide_sequence_column = roles$modified,
        precursor_quantity_column = roles$raw, precursor_normalised_column = roles$normalised,
        precursor_id_column = roles$precursor, precursor_charge_column = "Precursor.Charge",
        core_utilisation = cluster, is_logged_data = FALSE, return_rollup_result = TRUE))
    table <- NULL
    counts <- newDIAFilteringAccumulator(persist$prototype, roles$protein)
    metadata <- workflowSavedTableMetadata(result$data[0, , drop = FALSE], ".rownames", 3L)
    metadata$rows <- nrow(result$data)
    reference <- phase("summary_and_write", function() saveWorkflowTable(store, NULL,
        basename(tempfile("bulk-rollup-")), persist$identity, metadata$key_column,
        metadata = metadata, write_fn = function(path, restoration) {
            writer <- openWorkflowTableWriter(path, restoration, store$progress)
            on.exit(abortWorkflowTableWriter(writer), add = TRUE)
            for (start in seq.int(1L, max(1L, nrow(result$data)), by = 10000L)) {
                at <- if (nrow(result$data)) seq.int(start, min(nrow(result$data), start + 9999L)) else integer()
                counts$push(result$data[at, , drop = FALSE])
                appendWorkflowTableWriter(writer, result$data, at)
            }
            finishWorkflowTableWriter(writer)
        }))
    list(reference = reference, summary = result$summary, columns = names(result$data),
        dependencies = list(input$reference), counts = counts$finish())
}

#' Create an isolated replay using immutable payload links and independent metadata.
#' @param source_store Frozen committed store directory.
#' @param destination Fresh request-owned directory on the same filesystem.
#' @return Reopened reference adapter; original pending files are excluded.
#' @noRd
copyDIAReplayCheckpoint <- function(source_store, destination) {
    stopifnot(dir.exists(source_store), dir.exists(destination),
        !length(list.files(destination, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)))
    target <- file.path(destination, ".workflow-entities")
    stopifnot(dir.create(target))
    for (name in c("store.json", "dia-state-head.rds"))
        stopifnot(file.copy(file.path(source_store, name), target))
    files <- list.files(file.path(source_store, "entities"), recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    files <- files[!dir.exists(files)]
    for (path in files) {
        relative <- substring(path, nchar(source_store) + 2L)
        to <- file.path(target, relative)
        dir.create(dirname(to), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
        if (grepl("/payload[.](parquet|rds|qs2)$", path)) stopifnot(file.link(path, to)) else
            stopifnot(file.copy(path, to))
    }
    identity <- readSavedStoreIdentity(file.path(target, "store.json"))
    newDIAStateAdapter(newWorkflowEntityStore(destination, identity$project_id, identity$workflow_id), reopen = TRUE)
}

    withDIAStateScope(manager, function() commitDIAReferenceState(manager, "protein_peptide_filtered",
        checkpoint, list(seed = 902005L, forms = 2L, charges = 2L, annotation_bytes = 2048L),

        algo = "sha256"), source_hash))

#' Exercise the existing bounded access contract with an explicit eight-thread reader.
#' @param input Frozen I/O preparation record.
#' @param workload,reader Either index/wide and duckdb/fastduckdb.
#' @param root Existing guarded output directory.
#' @return A small measurement and exactness receipt.
#' @noRd
runDIARollupIO <- function(input, workload, reader, root, failure = FALSE) {
    started <- proc.time()
    store <- newWorkflowEntityStore(input$root, input$identity$project_id, input$identity$workflow_id)
    on.exit(closeWorkflowEntityStore(store), add = TRUE)
    scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(store, input[[workload]], reader = reader)
    on.exit(releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    if (reader == "duckdb") {
        DBI::dbExecute(scope$connection, "SET threads = 8")
        DBI::dbExecute(scope$connection, "SET memory_limit = '12GiB'")
    }
    read_fn <- readSavedWorkflowTable
    if (reader == "fastduckdb") {
        code <- deparse(body(read_fn), width.cutoff = 500L)
        stopifnot(sum(grepl("n_threads = 2L", code, fixed = TRUE)) == 1L)
        body(read_fn) <- parse(text = gsub("n_threads = 2L", "n_threads = 8L", code, fixed = TRUE))[[1L]]
    }
    columns <- scope$metadata$columns
    blocks <- split(columns, ceiling(seq_along(columns) / 64L))
    on.exit({
        releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope)
        stopifnot(store$open_resources == 0L)
        jsonlite::write_json(list(reader = reader, failure = failure, open_resources = store$open_resources),
            file.path(root, paste0("io-cleanup-", reader, "-", workload, "-", failure, ".json")), auto_unbox = TRUE)
    }, add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    results <- character(length(input$requests[[workload]]$offset))
    for (i in seq_along(results)) {
        values <- list()
        for (block in blocks) {
            page <- read_fn(store, input[[workload]], block,
                offset = input$requests[[workload]]$offset[[i]],
                limit = input$requests[[workload]]$limit[[i]], scope = scope, reader = reader)
            stopifnot(identical(rownames(page$data), as.character(
                input$requests[[workload]]$offset[[i]] + seq_len(nrow(page$data)))))
            if (failure) stop("injected bounded reader failure")
            values[block] <- unclass(page$data)
        }
        for (attribute in names(scope$metadata$attributes))
            attr(values, attribute) <- scope$metadata$attributes[[attribute]]
        attr(values, "row.names") <- .set_row_names(nrow(page$data))
        class(values) <- scope$metadata$class
        values <- restoreWorkflowAttributeOrder(values, scope$metadata$attribute_order)
        results[[i]] <- fingerprintDIARollupIO(values)
    }
    stopifnot(identical(unname(results), unname(input$expected[[workload]])))
    releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope)
    closeWorkflowEntityStore(store)
    list(status = "complete", reader = reader, threads = 8L, workload = workload,
        seconds = unname((proc.time() - started)[["elapsed"]]),
        cpu = unname(sum((proc.time() - started)[c("user.self", "sys.self")])),
        hashes = results, reference = input[[workload]]$entity_id,
        scope = "bounded projection/range consumer; not rollup computation")
}

#' Fingerprint bounded I/O values, preserving finite bits and NA/NaN distinctions.
#' @param data Restored bounded table; never an assay-sized input.
#' @return SHA256 with only automatic block row names and non-NaN NA payloads canonicalized.
#' @noRd
fingerprintDIARollupIO <- function(data) {
    attr(data, "row.names") <- .set_row_names(nrow(data))
    for (name in names(data)) if (is.double(data[[name]])) {
        # R arithmetic can quiet the NA payload; Parquet restores canonical NA.
        # This is an identical R missing value, not a numerical tolerance.
        missing <- is.na(data[[name]]) & !is.nan(data[[name]])
        if (any(missing)) data[[name]][missing] <- NA_real_
    }
    digest::digest(data, algo = "sha256")
}

#' Inspect physical sample pruning without executing a rollup or altering inputs.
#' @param proof,root Existing evidence and a fresh guarded output directory.
#' @return Bounded source statistics and aggregation-only physical plans.

        roles = list(sample = "Run", protein = "Protein.Group", peptide = "Stripped.Sequence",
            modified = "Modified.Sequence", precursor = "Precursor.Id",
            raw = "Precursor.Quantity", normalised = "Precursor.Normalised"))
    scope <- newDIARelationalScope(manager$.context$store, input, profile = "P3")
    on.exit(releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
    con <- scope$connection
    q <- function(x) as.character(DBI::dbQuoteIdentifier(con, x))
    DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE TEMP VIEW qc_input AS SELECT ",
        paste(q(c(unlist(input$roles), ".multischolar_order")), collapse = ","),
        " FROM read_parquet(", DBI::dbQuoteString(con, scope$path), ")"))
    samples <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, 'SELECT DISTINCT "Run" FROM qc_input ORDER BY "Run"')$Run
    stopifnot(length(samples) == 300L)
    plans <- list()
    for (profile in c("P0", "P6", "P3")) {
        selected <- if (profile == "P3") samples[1:100] else samples
        predicate <- if (profile == "P6") "" else paste0(' WHERE "Run" IN (',
            paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, selected), collapse = ","), ")")
        DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW qc_aggregate_input AS ",
            "SELECT * FROM qc_input", predicate))
        prepareDIARelationalAggregate(scope, input, "D")
        plans[[profile]] <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con,
            'EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM qc_aggregated ORDER BY "Run", "Protein.Group", "Stripped.Sequence"')
    }
    groups <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, paste0("SELECT row_group_id, row_group_num_rows, ",
        "stats_min_value, stats_max_value FROM parquet_metadata(?) WHERE path_in_schema = 'Run'"),
        params = list(scope$path))
    counts <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, 'SELECT "Run", count(*) AS rows FROM qc_input GROUP BY "Run" ORDER BY "Run"')
    stopifnot(nrow(groups) <= 10000L, nrow(counts) == 300L)
    overlap <- vapply(list(samples[1:100], samples[101:200], samples[201:300]), function(selected)
        sum(is.na(groups$stats_min_value) | is.na(groups$stats_max_value) |
            (groups$stats_min_value <= max(selected) & groups$stats_max_value >= min(selected))), integer(1))
    releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope)
    stopifnot(manager$.context$store$open_resources == 0L,
        identical(digest::digest(file = original_head, algo = "sha256"), original_hash))
    value <- list(status = "complete", source = input$reference, source_head_sha256 = original_hash,
        scope = "aggregation EXPLAIN plus file/sample metadata; no timed rollup or join attribution",
        row_groups = groups, groups_overlapping_each_batch = overlap,
        sample_rows = counts, plans = plans)
    jsonlite::write_json(value, file.path(root, "rollup-scan-inspection.json"),
        pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")
    value
}

    completed <- Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_WFX002_VERIFY_MEMBER", unset = "")
    skip_if(!nzchar(completed), "explicit bounded installed readback only")
    root <- dirname(Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA008_RECEIPT"))
    proof <- dirname(root)
    stopifnot(startsWith(normalizePath(completed), paste0(normalizePath(proof), "/")))
    # Preserve the wrongly located original receipt, and bind a recovery record.
    receipt_path <- file.path(completed, "relational-preflight.json")
    if (!file.exists(receipt_path)) receipt_path <- file.path(completed, "wfx-runtime", "finish.parquet")
    receipt <- jsonlite::read_json(receipt_path)
    expect_identical(receipt$status, "complete")
    expect_true(all(vapply(receipt$cases, function(case) isTRUE(case$exact), logical(1))))
    results <- readRDS(file.path(completed, "reader-tests.rds"))
    expect_true(all(results$failed == 0L & !results$error))
    source_store <- file.path(completed, "lifecycle-P14", ".workflow-entities")
    original_head <- digest::digest(file = file.path(source_store, "dia-state-head.rds"), algo = "sha256")
    clone <- file.path(root, "rollback-owned")
    dir.create(clone)
    expect_true(file.copy(source_store, clone, recursive = TRUE))
    owner <- readSavedStoreIdentity(file.path(clone, ".workflow-entities", "store.json"))
    store <- newWorkflowEntityStore(clone, owner$project_id, owner$workflow_id)
    manager <- newDIAStateAdapter(store, reopen = TRUE)
    record <- readDIAStateMetadata(manager)
    reference <- record$data$components$peptide_data
    scope <- newWorkflowTableReadScope(store, reference, reader = "duckdb")
    expect_lte(scope$metadata$rows, 10000L)
    actual <- readSavedWorkflowTable(store, reference, scope$metadata$columns, limit = 10000L,
        scope = scope)$data
    expected_hash <- digest::digest(actual, algo = "sha256")
    releaseWorkflowTableReadScope(scope)
    history <- manager$state_history
    output <- file.path(clone, "pending-output")
    dir.create(output)
    manager$.context$experiment_paths <- list(source_dir = output)
    expect_error(publishDIAActionOutputs(manager, getDIAStateReference(manager),
        "wfx-rollback", list(output = output), function(...) stop("owned pending output")),
        "owned pending output")
    expect_error(assertDIAExportReady(manager), class = "saved_entity_outputs_pending")
    closeDIAStateAdapter(manager)
    baseline <- file.path(dirname(proof), "browser-smoke.XsaPvT", "library")
    rollback <- callr::r(function(library, clone, owner) {
        .libPaths(c(library, .libPaths()))
        ns <- asNamespace("MultiScholaR")
        api <- function(name) get(name, ns)
        stopifnot(identical(normalizePath(getNamespaceInfo(ns, "path")),
            normalizePath(file.path(library, "MultiScholaR"))))
        store <- api("newWorkflowEntityStore")(clone, owner$project_id, owner$workflow_id)
        manager <- api("newDIAStateAdapter")(store, reopen = TRUE)
        on.exit(api("closeDIAStateAdapter")(manager))
        record <- api("readDIAStateMetadata")(manager)
        reference <- record$data$components$peptide_data
        scope <- api("newWorkflowTableReadScope")(store, reference, reader = "duckdb")
        on.exit(api("releaseWorkflowTableReadScope")(scope), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
        stopifnot(scope$metadata$rows <= 10000L)
        data <- api("readSavedWorkflowTable")(store, reference, scope$metadata$columns,
            limit = 10000L, scope = scope)$data
        pending <- tryCatch({ api("assertDIAExportReady")(manager); FALSE },
            saved_entity_outputs_pending = function(error) TRUE)
        list(hash = digest::digest(data, algo = "sha256"), history = manager$state_history,
            pending_recognized = pending)
    }, args = list(baseline, clone, owner))
    expect_identical(rollback$hash, expected_hash)
    expect_identical(rollback$history, history)
    expect_true(rollback$pending_recognized)
    expect_identical(digest::digest(file = file.path(source_store, "dia-state-head.rds"),
        algo = "sha256"), original_head)
    jsonlite::write_json(list(status = "complete", computation_repeated = FALSE,
        recovered_receipt = receipt_path, receipt_sha256 = digest::digest(file = receipt_path, algo = "sha256"),
        original_head_sha256 = original_head, rollback = rollback),
        file.path(root, "wfx-runtime-readback.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
})

test_that("completed writer measurements support independent readback recovery", {
    mode <- Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA025_MECHANISM_MEMBER")
    skip_if(!grepl("^gui-bulk-rollup:writer-r-readback:[A-Za-z0-9]{6}$", mode),
        "explicit verification of a retained completed operation only")
    root <- dirname(Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA008_RECEIPT"))
    proof <- dirname(root)
    member <- sub("^gui-bulk-rollup:writer-r-readback:", "", mode)
    original <- file.path(proof, paste0("browser-smoke.", member))
    receipt_path <- file.path(original, "writer-comparison.json")
    before <- digest::digest(file = receipt_path, algo = "sha256")
    receipt <- jsonlite::read_json(receipt_path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
    stopifnot(identical(receipt$case, "contrast"), !is.null(receipt$result$complete_operation_seconds),
        "teardown" %in% receipt$phases$phase)
    actual <- fingerprintDIAWriterOutput(file.path(original, paste0("arm-", receipt$arm)),
        receipt$result$reference)

    expect_identical(digest::digest(file = receipt_path, algo = "sha256"), before)

test_that("writer candidates use identical complete sample populations", {
    mode <- Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA025_MECHANISM_MEMBER")
    skip_if(!grepl("^gui-bulk-rollup:writer-r:(screen|full):(primary|contrast):P1[456]:[12]$", mode),
        "explicit unprofiled writer comparison only")
    fields <- strsplit(mode, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    screen <- fields[[3L]] == "screen"
    case <- fields[[4L]]
    arm <- fields[[5L]]
    root <- dirname(Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA008_RECEIPT"))
    proof <- dirname(root)
    withr::local_envvar(c(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
        DUCKPLYR_FALLBACK_AUTOUPLOAD = "0", DUCKPLYR_FALLBACK_COLLECT = "0"))
    if (case == "primary") source <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(proof,
        "browser-smoke.BpSyxB", "gui-state-latest.json")) else {
        manifests <- lapply(Sys.glob(file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.*",
            "rollup-qualification-inputs.json")), jsonlite::read_json)
        valid <- which(vapply(manifests, \(x) identical(x$status, "complete") &&
            identical(x$revision, "p3-adaptations-v1"), logical(1)))
        stopifnot(length(valid) == 1L)
        source <- manifests[[valid]]$cases$contrast
    }
    head <- file.path(source$store_directory, "dia-state-head.rds")
    head_hash <- digest::digest(file = head, algo = "sha256")
    stopifnot(identical(head_hash, if (case == "primary")
        "5d64ca562669d94eea1677a1a03d5b410a8a81d8ea59add8cabd6065deb91353" else source$head_sha256))
    owned <- file.path(root, paste0("arm-", arm))
    dir.create(owned)
    manager <- copyDIAReplayCheckpoint(source$store_directory, owned)
    on.exit(closeDIAStateAdapter(manager), add = TRUE)
    selectDIAStateReference(manager, "protein_peptide_filtered")
    checkpoint <- readDIAStateMetadata(manager)$data
    stopifnot(checkpoint$dimensions$rows == if (case == "primary") 24000000L else 3840000L)
    design <- withDIAStateScope(manager, function()
        readDIAExecutionComponents(manager, fields = "design_matrix"))@design_matrix
    samples <- if (!screen) NULL else as.character(design[[checkpoint$slots$sample_id]][
        if (case == "primary") c(1:4, 149:152, 297:300) else c(1:2, 24:25, 47:48)])
    receipt <- list(status = "running", mode = mode, arm = arm, case = case, samples = samples,
        source_head_sha256 = head_hash, profiling = FALSE, phases = list(), failures = list())
    receipt_path <- file.path(root, "writer-comparison.json")
    flush <- function() jsonlite::write_json(receipt, receipt_path, auto_unbox = TRUE,
        pretty = TRUE, null = "null", digits = NA)
    on.exit(flush(), add = TRUE)
    phase <- function(label, fn) {
        receipt$active_phase <<- label
        flush()
        started <- proc.time()
        value <- fn()
        receipt$phases[[length(receipt$phases) + 1L]] <<- list(phase = label,
            seconds = unname((proc.time() - started)[["elapsed"]]),
            cpu = unname(sum((proc.time() - started)[c("user.self", "sys.self")])))
        flush()
        value
    }
    tryCatch({
        started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
        value <- runDIABulkOperation(manager, owned, proof, arm, samples, phase)
        phase("teardown", function() closeDIAStateAdapter(manager))
        receipt$result <- c(value, list(complete_operation_seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started))
        hashes <- fingerprintDIAWriterOutput(owned, value$reference)
        receipt$result$output_hashes <- hashes
        oracle_id <- if (case == "primary") if (screen) "QGWkjJ" else "60v50g" else "EYBmKx"
        oracle_root <- file.path(proof, paste0("browser-smoke.", oracle_id))
        oracle <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(oracle_root, if (case == "primary")
            "bulk-rollup.json" else "rollup-qualification.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
        expected <- if (case == "primary") oracle$results[[1L]] else oracle$result
        if (screen && case == "contrast") {
            # Reuse the independently checked complete-sample native fingerprints.
            # Re-reading the entire wide native reference in every service would
            # measure oracle construction in its memory peak, not this operation.
            verified <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.1wXXDD",
                "writer-readback.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
            original_path <- file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.CHnC1c", "writer-comparison.json")
            original <- jsonlite::read_json(original_path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
            stopifnot(identical(verified$status, "complete"), isTRUE(verified$exact),
                identical(verified$source_member, "CHnC1c"),
                identical(verified$source_receipt_sha256, digest::digest(file = original_path, algo = "sha256")),
                identical(original$samples, samples))
            expected$output_hashes <- verified$output_hashes
        }
        expect_identical(hashes, expected$output_hashes)
        if (!screen || case == "primary") {
            expect_identical(jsonlite::toJSON(value$summary, auto_unbox = TRUE),
                jsonlite::toJSON(expected$summary, auto_unbox = TRUE))
        }
        expect_length(value$figures, 12L)
        expect_identical(value$execution$engine_threads, 8L)
        expect_identical(value$execution$writer_threads, 8L)
        expect_equal(value$execution$intermediate_bytes_written, 0)
        expect_identical(digest::digest(file = head, algo = "sha256"), head_hash)
        receipt$oracle <- oracle_id
        receipt$exact <- identical(hashes, expected$output_hashes)
        receipt$status <- "complete"
    }, error = function(error) {
        receipt$status <<- "failed"
        receipt$error <<- conditionMessage(error)
        flush()
        stop(error)
    })
    flush()
})

test_that("P14 writer attribution observes completion and failure", {

        DUCKPLYR_FALLBACK_AUTOUPLOAD = "0", DUCKPLYR_FALLBACK_COLLECT = "0"))
    diagnostic <- makeDIAWriterDiagnostic()
    testthat::local_mocked_bindings(appendWorkflowTableWriter = diagnostic$append,
        updateWorkflowFastWriter = diagnostic$update)
    receipt <- list(status = "running", mode = mode, profiling = TRUE, phases = list(), failures = list())
    receipt$source_hashes <- as.list(stats::setNames(vapply(c(
        "tests/testthat/helper-workflow-bulk-rollup.R",
        "tests/testthat/test-workflow-rollup-qualification.R",
        "tools/profiling/fastduckdb-writer-diagnostic.patch"),
        \(path) digest::digest(file = here::here(path), algo = "sha256"), character(1)),
        c("bulk_helper", "qualification_test", "native_diagnostics")))
    receipt_path <- file.path(root, "writer-attribution.json")
    flush <- function() {
        receipt$writer <- as.list(diagnostic$observations)
        jsonlite::write_json(receipt, receipt_path, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE,
            null = "null", digits = NA)
    }
    on.exit(flush(), add = TRUE)
    phase <- function(label, fn) {
        receipt$active_phase <<- label
        flush()
        started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
        value <- tryCatch(fn(), error = function(error) {
            receipt$failures[[length(receipt$failures) + 1L]] <<- list(phase = label,
                message = conditionMessage(error))
            stop(error)
        })
        receipt$phases[[length(receipt$phases) + 1L]] <<- list(phase = label,

        value

            expect_gt(native$concat_bytes, 0)
            expect_gt(native$flush_seconds, 0)
            failed <- openWorkflowTableWriter(file.path(root, "failed.parquet"), metadata,
                backend = "fast_r")

            appendWorkflowTableWriter(failed, table)
            temporary <- failed$write_path
            table$quantity <- as.character(table$quantity)
            expect_error(phase("injected_schema_failure", function()
                appendWorkflowTableWriter(failed, table)), "schema differs")
            abortWorkflowTableWriter(failed)
            expect_false(file.exists(temporary))
            expect_false(file.exists(failed$path))
            expect_identical(diagnostic$observations$completed, 3L)
            expect_identical(diagnostic$observations$failed, 1L)
            expect_length(receipt$failures, 1L)
        } else {
            case <- if (endsWith(mode, ":primary")) "primary" else "contrast"
            if (case == "primary") {
                source <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.BpSyxB", "gui-state-latest.json"))
            } else {
                manifests <- lapply(Sys.glob(file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.*",
                    "rollup-qualification-inputs.json")), jsonlite::read_json)
                valid <- which(vapply(manifests, \(x) identical(x$status, "complete") &&
                    identical(x$revision, "p3-adaptations-v1"), logical(1)))
                stopifnot(length(valid) == 1L)
                source <- manifests[[valid]]$cases$contrast
            }
            head <- file.path(source$store_directory, "dia-state-head.rds")
            receipt$source_head_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = head, algo = "sha256")
            stopifnot(identical(receipt$source_head_sha256, if (case == "primary")
                "5d64ca562669d94eea1677a1a03d5b410a8a81d8ea59add8cabd6065deb91353" else source$head_sha256))
            owned <- file.path(root, "arm-P14")
            dir.create(owned)
            manager <- copyDIAReplayCheckpoint(source$store_directory, owned)
            on.exit(closeDIAStateAdapter(manager), add = TRUE)
            selectDIAStateReference(manager, "protein_peptide_filtered")
            checkpoint <- readDIAStateMetadata(manager)$data
            stopifnot(checkpoint$dimensions$rows == if (case == "primary") 24000000L else 3840000L)
            design <- withDIAStateScope(manager, function()
                readDIAExecutionComponents(manager, fields = "design_matrix"))@design_matrix
            samples <- as.character(design[[checkpoint$slots$sample_id]][if (case == "primary")
                c(1:4, 149:152, 297:300) else c(1:2, 24:25, 47:48)])
            receipt$samples <- samples
            result <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
            profile <- profvis::profvis({
                result$value <- runDIABulkOperation(manager, owned, proof, "P14", samples, phase)
                phase("teardown", function() closeDIAStateAdapter(manager))
            }, interval = 0.01, prof_output = file.path(root, "writer.Rprof"), rerun = FALSE)
            value <- result$value
            if (is.null(value)) stop(if (length(receipt$failures))
                receipt$failures[[length(receipt$failures)]]$message else "profiled operation did not complete")
            saveRDS(profile, file.path(root, "writer-profvis.rds"), compress = FALSE)
            receipt$result <- value
            expect_identical(value$summary$input_precursor_rows,
                if (case == "primary") 960000L else 480000L)
            expect_gt(diagnostic$observations$completed, 0L)
            expect_identical(diagnostic$observations$failed, 0L)
            expect_identical(digest::digest(file = head, algo = "sha256"), receipt$source_head_sha256)
        }
        receipt$status <- "complete"
    }, error = function(error) {
        receipt$status <<- "failed"
        receipt$error <<- conditionMessage(error)

    })

                table <- makeWorkflowCheckpointPeptide(readWorkflowCheckpointRecipe("small"))@peptide_data[1:30, ]
                table$Run <- factor(table$Run, levels = c(unique(table$Run), "unused"))
                rownames(table) <- NULL
                index <- data.frame(source_order = seq_len(30L))
                identity <- list(input = "io-preflight", design = "fixed", parameters = "eight-threads",
                    selectors = "bounded", software = "bvT5nP")
                input <- list(root = owned, identity = store$identity,
                    index = saveWorkflowTable(store, index, "index", identity, ".rownames", metadata_version = 3L),
                    wide = saveWorkflowTable(store, table, "wide", identity, ".rownames", metadata_version = 3L),
                    requests = list(index = list(offset = c(0L, 10L, 20L), limit = c(5L, 5L, 5L)),
                        wide = list(offset = c(0L, 10L, 20L), limit = c(5L, 5L, 5L))))
                input$expected <- lapply(list(index = index, wide = table), function(data)
                    vapply(c(0L, 10L, 20L), function(offset) {
                        value <- data[offset + seq_len(5L), , drop = FALSE]
                        fingerprintDIARollupIO(restoreWorkflowAttributeOrder(value, names(attributes(data))))
                    }, character(1)))
                closeWorkflowEntityStore(store)
                readers <- c("duckdb", "fastduckdb")
            } else {
                inputs <- Sys.glob(file.path(proof, "browser-smoke.*", "rollup-io-inputs-v2.rds"))
                stopifnot(length(inputs) == 1L)
                input <- readRDS(inputs[[1L]])
                stopifnot(identical(input$revision, "codec-attributes-v2"))
                readers <- strsplit(mode, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]][[3L]]
                receipt$input_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = inputs[[1L]], algo = "sha256")
            }
            started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
            for (reader in readers) for (workload in c("index", "wide")) {
                key <- paste(reader, workload, sep = ":")
                receipt$active <- key
                flush()
                receipt$results[[key]] <- runDIARollupIO(input, workload, reader, root)
                if (mode == "gui-bulk-rollup:io-preflight") {
                    expect_error(runDIARollupIO(input, workload, reader, root, failure = TRUE),
                        "injected bounded reader failure")
                    cleanup <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(root,
                        paste0("io-cleanup-", reader, "-", workload, "-TRUE.json")))
                    expect_identical(cleanup$open_resources, 0L)
                    receipt$failures[[key]] <- list(injected = TRUE, cleanup = cleanup)
                }
                flush()
            }
            receipt$complete_operation_seconds <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started
            if (mode == "gui-bulk-rollup:io-preflight") {
                real <- repairDIARollupIOInputs(proof, root)
                # Check every frozen request before admitting any timed member.
                for (reader in readers) for (workload in c("index", "wide")) {
                    key <- paste("prepared", reader, workload, sep = ":")
                    receipt$active <- key
                    flush()
                    receipt$results[[key]] <- runDIARollupIO(real, workload, reader, root)
                }
                saveRDS(real, file.path(root, "rollup-io-inputs-v2.rds"), compress = FALSE)
                receipt$verified_prepared_requests <- TRUE
            }
        }
        receipt$status <- "complete"
    }, error = function(error) {
        receipt$status <<- "failed"
        receipt$error <<- conditionMessage(error)
        stop(error)
    })
    flush()
})

test_that("the direct native writer build is isolated and source-bound", {
    skip_if(!Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA025_MECHANISM_MEMBER") %in% c("gui-bulk-rollup:writer-build", "gui-bulk-rollup:writer-opt-build"),
        "explicit isolated native build only")

    proof <- dirname(root)
    request_name <- if (Sys.getenv("MULTISCHOLAR_DIA025_MECHANISM_MEMBER") == "gui-bulk-rollup:writer-opt-build") "fast-writer-opt-source.json" else "fast-writer-source.json"
    request <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(proof, request_name))
    sources <- names(request$files)
    stopifnot(all(vapply(sources, function(path) identical(
        digest::digest(file = file.path(request$source, path), algo = "sha256"), request$files[[path]]), logical(1))))
    destination <- file.path(root, "source")
    dir.create(destination)
    for (path in list.files(request$source, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
        stopifnot(file.copy(path, destination, recursive = TRUE))
    package <- file.path(destination, "fastduckdb")
    cache <- file.path(package, "src", ".cargo")
    dir.create(cache)
    for (path in list.files(request$cargo_cache, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
        stopifnot(file.copy(path, cache, recursive = TRUE))
    library <- file.path(root, "library")
    dir.create(library)
    withr::local_envvar(c(CARGO_BUILD_JOBS = "8", CARGO_NET_OFFLINE = "true"))
    status <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "R"), c("CMD", "INSTALL",
        shQuote(paste0("--library=", library)), shQuote(package)))
    stopifnot(status == 0L)
    jsonlite::write_json(list(status = "complete", source = request,
        library = library, source_copy = destination, threads = 8L,
        version = read.dcf(file.path(library, "fastduckdb", "DESCRIPTION"))[1L, "Version"],
        binaries = stats::setNames(vapply(list.files(file.path(library, "fastduckdb"),
            "[.](so|rdb|rdx)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE),
            function(path) digest::digest(file = path, algo = "sha256"), character(1)),
            list.files(file.path(library, "fastduckdb"), "[.](so|rdb|rdx)$", recursive = TRUE))),
        file.path(root, "fast-writer-build.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
})
